# Troika! System JSON

> Machine-readable JSON and JSON-LD reference corpus for the Troika! SRD. 225 records with JSON Schema validation.

Attribution: Based on the Troika! SRD by Melsonian Arts Council and dialectrical. Troika! System JSON is an independent production by Chee Leong and is not affiliated with the Melsonian Arts Council.

## Entry points

- [Full corpus context](https://cheeleong.dev/troika-system-json/llms-full.txt): complete text projection of every record
- [Reference manifest](https://cheeleong.dev/troika-system-json/objects/troika-system-data.json): collection lists using JSON References
- [Single-file bundle](https://cheeleong.dev/troika-system-json/objects/troika-system-data.bundled.json): every record in one document
- [Search index](https://cheeleong.dev/troika-system-json/objects/search-index.json): static inverted token index
- [Collection index](https://cheeleong.dev/troika-system-json/objects/collection-index.json): compact browse metadata
- [JSON-LD context](https://cheeleong.dev/troika-system-json/systems/context.jsonld)

## Collections

- Backgrounds: 36 records under `objects/backgrounds/`
- Advanced skills: 22 records under `objects/skills/`
- Spells: 74 records under `objects/spells/`
- Items: 50 records under `objects/items/`
- Enemies: 36 records under `objects/enemies/`
- Tables: 5 records under `objects/tables/`
- Sample characters: 2 records under `objects/characters/`
